timing_scope: Diagnostic requests only. Wall extend+accept is a combined phase; CUDA events measure elapsed stream spans including idle, not isolated GPU busy time. Missing GPU events stay null.

resources.interpretation: NVML, RSS and system cache overlap: never sum them. System extrema may occur at different instants and include other processes. One-second polling can miss brief peaks; process peak differences are observations, not an attributable physical-RAM saving.

suffix_total_scope: All 82 suffix-on requests including quality, cancellation and diagnostics; not a performance workload aggregate.
